description: Six barred cells flank a five-wide central processional aisle; guard desk at rear flank and overhead chains.
differences: Original perspective cutaway completed with roof and enclosing walls.
Iron doors exported open for collision verification; adjacent levers are vanilla controls, door-cycle gameplay untested.
Decorative keys absent; barrels empty; no prisoners, locks or spawn logic.
Shallow coral gutters replace fully flooded corridor; end ports remain dry above waterline.
water_policy: Shallow contained display pools, raised dry traversable ports; no ocean placement survival claim.
